content.short: Moralis is a leading one-stop shop for building web3 applications.
content.description: Moralis is a platform designed to simplify web3 development. Established in 2021 by Swedish founder Ivan Liljeqvist (CEO) and Filipino founder Martinsson (COO), it provides developers with a broad suite of tools that accelerate dapp creation by integrating a wide range of web3 services. The platform prioritizes seamless API interoperability across services and offers reliable, responsive support, enabling teams to streamline backend tasks, reduce boilerplate, and focus on delivering feature-rich experiences to users.
content.meta: Moralis provides APIs and tooling to build, launch, and scale Web3 applications faster. Discover Moralis and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
